questions.stem: A battery transfers 60 J of energy when 20 C of charge flows through it. What is the potential difference of the battery?
questions.explanation: Using V = E/Q = 60/20 = 3 V. The potential difference equals the energy transferred divided by the charge that flows.

questions.stem: What does a potential difference of 12 V across a lamp mean?

options.text: 12 coulombs of charge flow through the lamp every second
12 joules of energy are transferred for every coulomb of charge that passes through the lamp
The lamp has a resistance of 12 ohms
12 electrons pass through the lamp every second

questions.explanation: A potential difference of 12 V means that 12 joules of electrical energy are converted to other forms (such as light and heat) for every coulomb of charge that passes through the lamp.
